sections.heading: 7 Reasons To Commit To Your Focused Future
sections.body: Seven reasons the Library earns its place beside your core programme.

reasons: Your future self will thank you: every lesson stays available on the days when a real project needs that exact idea again.
Review at your own speed: pause, rewind and revisit difficult steps until the method is fully yours, not half remembered.
Workbooks turn watching into doing: each lesson ends with structured exercises that convert ideas into finished work.
A busy week stops being a lost week: the archive lets you catch up completely instead of returning to find gaps.
Bonus sessions deepen the core material: extra recordings explore the advanced applications the live schedule cannot fit.
One organised archive replaces scattered notes: everything lives in a single place you can search in seconds.
You already committed to the core programme: the Library makes sure that commitment keeps paying you back for years.
